air_sea.air_temperature: surface_temperature_target + offset + diurnal cycle + air masses
air_sea.bulk_formulae: Dalton evaporation, Stanton sensible heat, Berliand longwave; surface energy balance implicit
air_sea.wind_speed: 10 m wind equivalent to the wind stress

hosing.profile: F = min(max_sv, ramp (t - start)), fresh water at 0 degC spread evenly over the region's sea cells

surface_temperature.profile: linear in north, Gaussian cold patches blended in

warming.profile: dT = min(max_k, rate (t - start)) x amplification, linear from south to north, added to the surface-temperature target and the air

wind.profile: tau_x = -tau_0 cos(gyres pi y' / L') with y' = max(0, y - south_margin), L' = L_y - south_margin; times the wall taper (1 - exp(-(y/taper)^2)) (1 - exp(-((L_y - y)/taper)^2)) when set

source.bed: terrain elevation of the region's land cells
source.coupling: air temperature of the air-sea forcing over the land, reduced by the lapse rate to the ice surface; ocean thermal forcing at the front depth from the layered column; meltwater liquid at 0 degC, icebergs and frontal melt as ice melting in the top layer

thermal_layers.coordinate: sigma fractions of the active-layer thickness, top first
